outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: The Tawny Owl (Strix aluco) is a species of owl resident in much of Europe and southern Russia.

outgoing.name: Ireland
outgoing.excerpt: However, in Ireland, where there are no Tawnies, the Long-eared Owl is found in all suitable woodland.

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: The Tawny Owl (Strix aluco) is a species of owl resident in much of Europe and southern Russia.

outgoing.name: William Shakespeare
outgoing.excerpt: The call of the Tawny Owl is the tu-whit tu-whoo immortalised by William Shakespeare.
